_about: Queue settings for pull_queues.py --state OK. name is the State/Province value in the GEM export; markets are the queues read (all of Oklahoma sits in the Southwest Power Pool, so SPP is the one market; the panhandle's Xcel territory is SPP too); owner and shared_owner are only used for MISO's state-blank rows and are empty here; pjm_states is empty; known is hand-checked patterns, GEM plant id to regexes that name that plant in a point of interconnection, project name or developer. Every match still says check. A county-only match is never a known match: GEN-2024-340 (1,440 MW, Creek County, AEP) is not Bristow Energy Center (420 MW, Associated Electric), and the AES 5 rows in Oklahoma County are not Horseshoe Lake.
name: Oklahoma
known_set: 2026-11-03, from the SPP active queue read that day. Hugo matches GEN-2026-SR34 (Fort Towson, 75 MW) and GEN-2024-323 (ITC Hugo 7, 372 MW), which are Hugo Site A and Site B; Muskogee matches GEN-2025-SR9 (400 MW) and GEN-2024-293 (Muskoge7, 248 MW), which may be OG&E units or the Core Scientific data center plant; Northeastern matches ERAS-2025-023 (513 MW Oologah); Comanche matches ERAS-2025-024 and ERAS-2025-026 (775.2 MW each, Lawton).
